results.question: Show each order ID with the name of the customer who placed it.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, c.name
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY o.order_id;
results.expected_sql: SELECT orders.order_id, customers.name FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id ORDER BY orders.order_id

results.question: Find the total quantity ordered for each product, including products never ordered.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY p.product_id;
results.expected_sql: SELECT products.name, COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity), 0) FROM products LEFT JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY products.product_id, products.name ORDER BY products.product_id

results.question: Find the total value of items in each order.
results.expected_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id

results.question: Find the highest-priced product in each category.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.category, p.name, p.price
FROM products p
JOIN (
    SELECT category, MAX(price) AS max_price
    FROM products
    GROUP BY category
) mp ON p.category = mp.category AND p.price = mp.max_price
ORDER BY p.category, p.product_id;
results.expected_sql: SELECT category, MAX(price) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
results.error: Column count mismatch: got 3 columns, expected 2 columns.

results.question: Find the total amount spent on order items by each customer across all their orders.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.customer_id;
results.expected_sql: SELECT customers.name, COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price), 0) FROM customers LEFT JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.name ORDER BY customers.customer_id

results.question: Find orders whose total item value exceeds 1000.

ORDER BY order_id;
